title: Feature
description: A feature as seen by one recipient in sessionState. `criteria` and `score` are null when `votingInProgress` is true and the recipient is not the facilitator (FR-019a); a feature with no value entered has an empty `criteria` object.

version.description: Optimistic lock: sent back in updateFeature and deleteFeature.

markedForReview.description: Facilitator reminder (FR-006a); no effect on score or sort.

votingInProgress.description: Optional, absent means false. Set by the server from user story 2 on, while the feature is in an open round.
